title: Playback
openFromEditorHint: Open this one in synced playback: follow along as it plays, and click any line to jump to that moment.
queuedHint: Added to the processing queue — waiting…

speed.label: Playback speed
speed.cycle: Speed {{rate}}×, click for the next step

bilingual.label: Display mode
bilingual.needTranslation: Run “Translate” first to generate a translation

fullEdit.title: Full-transcript editing
fullEdit.empty: Cue text cannot be empty (use the row Delete action to drop it)
fullEdit.hint: Proofread the whole transcript line by line; double-click a single cue to edit after exiting

edit.label: Edit cue at {{time}}
edit.empty: Cue text cannot be empty (use Delete to drop the whole cue)
edit.doubleClickHint: Click to seek, double-click to edit
edit.deleteHint: Delete this cue entirely (sponsor reads, filler, hallucinated silence)
edit.deleteDesc: This cue's text is removed from the transcript; the audio is untouched.
edit.deleteConfirmHint: Click once more to delete this cue; press Esc to cancel

speaker.assignHint: Click to assign a speaker (this line / this turn / all)

scopeHint.following: Reassign this line and the following lines by the same speaker (one turn)
scopeHint.all: Reassign every line of this speaker (i.e. merge two speakers)

assigned.all: All lines of that speaker reassigned

speaker.split: Split — now assign a speaker to the second line
speaker.splitTip: Two speakers in one line? Switch to “Edit text”, put the cursor at the boundary and choose “Split at cursor”.
speaker.splitHint: Split into two lines at the cursor and assign the second half to a new speaker (its translation must be redone)
speaker.mergeHint: Merge this line back into the previous one (inverse of split)

status.downloading: Downloading the recording from the cloud {{pct}}%…

video.title: Video playback
video.hiddenHint: Picture hidden, audio only. Choose Split or Theater to bring it back.
video.dragHint: Drag to move the mini player

quality.cps: Too fast to read — trim this line, or merge it with a neighbour so it stays longer
quality.too-long: On screen too long — split it at a sentence boundary
quality.summary: {{flagged}} of {{total}} cues are unreadable or linger too long (line length and wrapping are handled on export)

nowPlaying.label: Now playing: {{title}}
nowPlaying.followHint: Scroll the editor to the line being played
nowPlaying.pictureHint: Whether video follows you as a floating window, or only audio keeps playing

playHereHint: Listen inside the note; click a timestamped line to jump

knowledge.previewOnly: This recording only has the live text captured while recording, so it can't back a topic page yet. Transcribe it again to fix that.
knowledge.askTitle: Can future recordings and transcripts be used for your topics?
knowledge.askBody: If you allow it, finished recordings and transcripts that match a topic's scope are processed by {{where}} to prepare cited suggestions for topic pages; nothing is written until you confirm. This applies to this device and this vault only, and you can turn it off on a topic page.
